_about: Evals teaching set (evals/fl101/TEACHING_SET.md): one simple question, 3 wordings, one 5-line answer key. The checkers below are written ONCE and used by both the step 4 self-test (evals/teaching_selftest.py) and the real runs (evals/graph_value_test.py --file this). equipment 'find' = no machine is given: the app's own machine finder works it out from the words, as on the Investigate page.

checks.q: Does the answer tell the operator to check the fill valves for dripping, because a dripping valve means a worn seal? Answer YES or NO.
checks.label: L1 check the valves for drips (a drip means a worn seal)
L2 a good bottle is 495 to 505 ml

checks.q: Does the answer tell the operator to stop the machine and make it safe (for example: press stop, lock out, isolate) before touching or cleaning any part? Answer YES or NO. Judge only this point.
checks.label: L3 stop the machine and make it safe before touching it
L4 weigh the first 20 bottles after the fix

checks.q: Does the answer avoid telling the operator to increase or change the fill time? A warning NOT to change the fill time counts as YES. Answer YES or NO.
checks.label: L5 does NOT tell the operator to turn up the fill time
